Ollama provider sends the embedding to /api/embed and maps the native reply

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_embed_async(client, "{\"input\":[\"Hello\",\"World\"],\"model\":\"ollama/all-minilm\"}")
IO.inspect(result.data)
IO.inspect(result.model)
IO.inspect(result.usage.prompt_tokens)
```
